high_level_description: The image is a tweet from Neil deGrasse Tyson, an astronomer and astrophysicist, on the X platform (formerly known as Twitter). The tweet includes a prophetic statement about the impact of advanced AI on the credibility of news and social media. Header: The tweet starts with "PROPHESY:" indicating that it is a prediction or forecast. Content: The main message reads: "When AI perfects deep-fakes of people, places, & things, no news will be trusted. Even those who previously believed fake news will think their fake news is faked.
